item.title: Ep 1 · What happened when AI became a second reader in breast screening?
item.description:
AI-generated: AI-written script and synthetic voices, checked automatically against the papers credited below. Not medical advice.
Sam's listen-through guide (riskiest first; times are approximate): - about 22:14 (line 145): 'What does this mean for the NHS?' before nations are named; listen for a sweeping NHS-wide claim - about 13:59 (line 93): Study name GEMINI beside Google's Gemini voices; check the 'nothing to do with' disclaimer is clear - about 0:31 (line 5): Google voices plus Google-provided tool, 'bear it in mind'; listen for hinting at bias or a link - about 21:46 (line 143): 'It found' could be heard as GEMINI rather than MASAI; check who found what - about 19:18 (line 125): Vara funding and employees named, other declared interests omitted; listen for tone implying bias - about 16:51 (line 110): 'Though ... independently' after employee disclosure; listen for a defensive or reassuring tone about the company - about 12:28 (line 83): Second paper's simulation set against the lead paper; listen for a sneer or dig - about 25:47 (line 170): First takeaway: check 'NHS' has a place, 'nearly half' and the favourable framing sound neutral; The takeaways (lines 170 to 172): the strongest claims
Named in this episode: organisations and products NHS, NHS Breast Screening Programme, NHS Grampian, Google, Anthropic, National Institute for Health and Care Research (NIHR), Vara, Sweden's national screening programme, Germany's screening programme, Google's Gemini (the show's synthetic voices), Vara's AI system including its 'safety net' feature; studies and trials GEMINI, PRAIM, MASAI, ScreenTrustCAD, EDITH trial; journals Nature Cancer, Nature Medicine, British Journal of Cancer.
## Credits
Each paper below was summarised and adapted for audio by AI. Its authors and journal don't endorse the show.
- **Lead paper:** Warren LM, Venton J, Young KC, Halling-Brown M, Kelly CJ, Wilson M, et al. "Impact of using artificial intelligence as a second reader in breast screening including arbitration." *Nature Cancer*, 2026. https://doi.org/10.1038/s43018-026-01128-z (Europe PMC PMC13035470). Licence: [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). - **Supporting paper:** Kelly CJ, Wilson M, Warren LM, Sidebottom R, Halling-Brown M, Yang L, et al. "Diagnostic accuracy, fairness and clinical implementation of AI for breast cancer screening: results of multicenter retrospective and prospective technical feasibility studies." *Nature Cancer*, 2026. https://doi.org/10.1038/s43018-026-01127-0 (Europe PMC PMC13035471). Licence: [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). - **Supporting paper:** de Vries CF, Lip G, Staff RT, Dymiter JA, Tse B, Ng A, et al. "Prospective evaluation of artificial intelligence integration into breast cancer screening in multiple workflow settings: the GEMINI study." *Nature Cancer*, 2026. https://doi.org/10.1038/s43018-026-01126-1 (Europe PMC PMC13035467). Licence: [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). - **Supporting paper:** Eisemann N, Bunk S, Mukama T, Baltus H, Elsner SA, Gomille T, et al. "Nationwide real-world implementation of AI for cancer detection in population-based mammography screening." *Nature Medicine*, 2025. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41591-024-03408-6 (Europe PMC PMC11922743). Licence: [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). - **Supporting paper:** Hill H, Roadevin C. "Economic evaluation of artificial intelligence for cancer detection in the UK breast screening programme." *British Journal of Cancer*, 2026. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41416-026-03465-3 (Europe PMC PMC13373195). Licence: [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
Named but not used: the MASAI trial (Sweden). Its papers didn't pass our licence check, so only what the GEMINI paper reports about it is mentioned.
## About this episode
Hosts Nina and Rob are AI-generated: synthetic voices made with Google's Gemini, and a script written by AI (Claude, from Anthropic) from the papers above, checked automatically against them. Google provided the AI tool evaluated in two of the papers. Produced by Sam. For discussion and learning, not medical advice.
Corrections: none yet. Errors are corrected at the start of the next episode.
